title: Bundle Bin
description: A craftable Bundle that deletes it's contents, great for clearing up junk from your inventory
body:
It's just a bundle but the contents gets removed every 5 ticks, still works the same as a vanilla bundle.

You can craft it with any bundle, a lava bucket and a wither skull.

![crafting recipe for the beanbag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0b1a4982945a8e4a602fe57f1a24b7de35fd6a5.png)

Check out the resource pack to make it easier to distinguish the Bundle Bin in your inventory.

https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bundle-bin-resourcepack

It's a bean bag
